## Purpose
Builds the graph the refine canvas draws: the workflow as it is, or as a previewed proposal would make it, with added, changed and removed steps marked. Removed steps stay as ghosts.

## Responsibilities
- `revisionGraph(definition, proposal)` draws the proposed steps plus ghosts of the removed ones, and every link the proposal cuts.
